title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Ghost Market
overview: Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all... his own family.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: The Summer We Had
overview: As adulthood approaches, seven lifelong friends experience one final summer that will change their lives forever.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: The Final Hour
overview: A group of friends find themselves trapped in a deadly situation as a mysterious killer begins hunting them one by one during the final hour.

title: Jason Statham Stole My Bike
overview: Jason Statham in the role of a lifetime, playing global action superstar Jason Statham. Plot TBA.

title: Relentless
overview: The story of a former soldier and an underground fighter who is diagnosed with cancer and is left with the decision to keep fighting to provide for his family in the long run. The joint battle with cancer versus the battle in the arena.

title: The Stolen Tape
overview: A noir action comedy about a detective trying to retrieve a missing videotape.

title: Some Other Story
overview: Upon moving back to her hometown, a nostalgic Noelle reunites with her childhood flame Matthew to relive their final date before leaving their lingering feelings in the past. But will they be able to?

title: The Elephant's Present
overview: James comes home for the holidays with the intention of repairing the strained relationship with his daughter.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: When Worlds Collide
overview: Lana Maxwell becomes the prime suspect in the murder of her friend Veronica. Watch as her life unfolds and she deals with the challenges that being a teenager brings. Meanwhile Evelyn Jackson is going through friend group problems, and decides to make friends with a controversial figure.

title: The Wicked Hour
overview: A documentary director gathers her friends to document a haunted house, only to witness horrific paranormal activity.

title: Brute 1986
overview: Leather Kobra, a Sunset Strip-style glam metal band, films a music video in an abandoned Western town in the middle of nowhere. Ignoring ‘no trespassing’ signs, the rebellious group have no idea they are being watched by the Birdy family, who will meet them with a level of brutality that is as vicious as it is creative.

title: I HAD A... (DREAM)
overview: I HAD A... (DREAM) unfolds as a trip where dance, stop-motion animation, sound, and imagery interplay, far from established dimensions and expectations. Mushrooms immerse the viewer in a dreamlike space, where the film becomes a site for deviation and disruption.

title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
original_title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

title: MEN TOO
overview: A man struggles to stay strong after a painful divorce, moving through his days with a quiet loneliness that no one notices. This PSA explores how a single moment of genuine care can change everything for someone who feels forgotten.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: Little Flower
overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

title: Hot Wieners and Coffee Milk
overview: On the night before Halloween in a small New England town, a local hot wiener delivery driver attempts to get out of work on time for a holiday tradition he’s kept since childhood. Things prove difficult as he navigates car troubles, a rival pizza delivery driver, and a cast of lonely regulars all keeping him stuck.

title: A Tradutora
overview: Whilst working on the Portuguese version of a medieval Japanese tale about a female hermit at a forest, a young translator begins to pay frequent visits to the local florist's.

title: Medicine Ball
overview: Medicine Ball follows Native college athletes Lexus and Leroy as they uncover their university’s dark history as a former Indian boarding school, revealing how basketball is more than a game—it’s a symbol of hope, resilience, and cultural pride in Native communities.

title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.

title: Pactum
overview: Six high-society women gather in a mansion bound by a secret pact, a pact one of them has broken and whose consequences will be disastrous. Who is the traitor?

title: Sydney vs. Sean
overview: SYDNEY VS SEAN follows Sydney, a red-carpet host chasing perfection, and Sean, a bisexual nurse clinging to independence. A hookup grows into a passionate but volatile romance. After a year apart, the turbulent day of their divorce signing ricochets between past and present. When their eccentric notary arrives, he witnesses two lovers confront a bond that can’t be sustained, yet refuses to fade. Starring JANEL PARRISH (Pretty Little Liars, "To All The Boys" Trilogy) , T.R. KNIGHT (Grey's Anatomy, The Flight Attendant), RYAN POWERS (She-Hulk, The Mandalorian), and ARDEN MYRIN (Free Bert, The Righteous Gemstones)

title: Plan B
overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

title: Nothing
overview: Time passes by as a man tries to navigate the monotony of every day life.

title: Power-Man
overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Twincredible!
overview: With the final innings of the 1991 World Series buzzing through their television set, this portrait of struggling new parents Bert and Annette unfolds over one night in their half-finished home, where an argument stirs emotions neither of them fully understand.

title: Gracie Sees a Ghost
overview: A documentary investigating a family annihilation case and the enigma of its perpetrator, Gracie Donaghue.

title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
original_title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
overview: Six months after his harrowing escape from a mysterious Russian island, Jake Fernsby is still drowning in PTSD. When a distress signal suddenly comes up from a missing fighter pilot, Jake and a crack team of soldiers are selected to save the pilot. Unbeknownst to Jake and his squad, they're being sent straight into the Beast's home turf.

title: Rated
overview: Maggie must find the courage to own up to her behavior when she wakes to find every adult has received a YELP-like Star rating floating above their head. While most adults have a shining 4 or 5 stars, Maggie's got just 2.5.

title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have shared the fourth and final installment of “Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour: Philadelphia Freedom Cut,” featuring official video of the full encore from that May 30 show. Kicking off with “American Land” and building to signature live staples “Born to Run,” “Dancing In The Dark” and “Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out,” the performance concludes with The E Street Band version of Bob Dylan’s classic “Chimes Of Freedom.”

title: Terrifying Film
overview: This is scary

title: Michelle Wolf: For Linda
overview: Michelle Wolf at the DC Improv

title: Spoon
overview: A ritual is seen taking place, while results come to fruition, it is still considered a failure.

title: Anthony Lin's The Lull
overview: Camp Counselor Jason wakes up inside an empty car. Scared out of his mind, things unseen haunt Jason as he must come face-to-face to an eerie consequence lurking. Lurking all around him till his night’s end.

title: What Are Friends For?
overview: Friends are seen having a disagreement over an issue of serious import.

title: Powerhouse Supreme
overview: An FBI agent on the brink of losing his job gets one last chance to save his employment by completing a top secret mission.

title: World Walker
overview: “Who’s he talking to?”  When a mysterious world walker travels from earth 8 to a different world to the one we live in and he encounters residents and then this leads to events happening

title: There Goes the Neighbourhood
overview: A look into the story of the Australian punk squat “the Esso” told through interviews with its old inhabitants. Exploring a vital part of Melbourne’s hardcore punk history.

title: Chloe
overview: An experimental short film that explores fragile relationship between memory, identity, and desire to preserve what time inevitably takes from us.

title: Don’t Cry Over Spilled Milk
overview: Feller Tomlinson goes on a short walk in a town and has to face the consequence's of his prior actions

title: "2 Hungary 2 Handle" - A Top Gear Story
original_title: "2 Hungary 2 Handle" - A Top Gear Story
overview: Tasked with organising a four-day stag weekend in Budapest, Daniel brings together groom-to-be Henry and 16 of his closest friends and family for a weekend of chaos, drinking and questionable decisions. But beyond the madness lies a portrait of Henry’s life, told through the people who know him best.

title: The Many Hands of Sekar Neferu
original_title: The Many Hands of Sekar Neferu
overview: Seeking to rid his arm of a curse, Kasten heads to the Tears of the First Martyr - a sacred waterfall said to heal any wound. However, upon arrival he is met with a blighted land and an abandoned temple. But is he alone, or do the many hands of Sekar Neferu still guard this ruin?

title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
original_title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

title: Searching 4 Saturn
overview: Set against Alabama A&M’s Homecoming Week, Searching 4 Saturn follows poet and scholar Joshua Baker as they muse on southern inheritance across time and space. The film asks what it means to be Black and Queer in a state caught between cycles of oppression and resistance.

title: Rancho Mirage
overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
overview: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

title: Backflip Crazy
overview: A comic book artist sets off on a research assignment with a martial arts master while her insecure boyfriend stomps around with jealousy and fragile masculinity. Things take a turn when he challenges the Sensei to perform a backflip. Things get a lil' backflip crazy...

title: Dan & Kat Hide a Body
overview: Dan and Kat are social media influencers on a couples vacation to Venezuela. When they accidentally hit a woman with their car, their picture-perfect getaway takes a dark turn. Rather than face the consequences, they attempt to hide the body and cover up what happened. Dark hilarity ensues as they scramble to evade accountability from both the law and the internet, while desperately maintaining their carefully curated online personas.

title: Danhausen’s Very Nice, Very Evil Halloween Special
original_title: Danhausen’s Very Nice, Very Evil Halloween Special
overview: Kick off your Halloween celebration with Danhausen as he welcomes the WWE Universe into his laboratory for an evening of spooky matches, scary Superstars and special guest appearances.

title: THE SNORE
overview: Good night. All tucked in. But then the snore begins. What starts as a woman's irritation of her boyfriend’s snoring curdles into obsession, and sleeplessness mutates into something monstrous. Parasitic, the snore burrows into her mind. Her world shrinks to the rhythm of his breath. Reality warps. The house becomes a fever dream of noise and rage. By morning, the question remains: who’s the real monster? The snorer, or the one who can’t bear to hear it?

title: Stacey Dooley: Death In The Barracks
original_title: Stacey Dooley: Death In The Barracks
overview: Stacey Dooley explores the death of 19-year-old soldier Jaysley Beck as her family fights for justice, asking whether the army does enough to protect young women.

title: Champions of Change: Heart of a Saint
original_title: Champions of Change: Heart of a Saint
overview: In New Orleans, three men shaped by growing up without fathers - including NFL champion Tyrann Mathieu, famously known as the “Honey Badger” - return to their communities to become the mentors they once needed. Their mission is to inspire, uplift, and help build a stronger future for the city that raised them. The documentary beautifully intertwines Mathieu's story with those of local mentees and mentors, exploring the shared experiences of growing up without a father, overcoming adversity, and finding strength through mentorship, resilience, and community. These are stories of loss, but more importantly, stories of hope.

title: Our Big Great Totally Awesome (And Practical) Escape
original_title: Our Big Great Totally Awesome (And Practical) Escape
overview: A younger sibling sneaks their brother out of a burn unit in a California psychiatric ward, going on a journey that involves cigarettes, ice cream and video game worlds as they chase an impossible plan to rowboat home to Hawai‘i, drifting further into a dream neither can hold onto.

title: Run
overview: London has fallen. Food is scarce, hope is fading, and the undead roam the streets. When two survivors embark on a dangerous supply run, an encounter with the infected forces them apart. Alone in a city overrun by the dead, each must fight to survive and find their way back to the other.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: Thick Skin
overview: A group of wannabe influencers discovers that one of their "friends" has an unusual talent

title: Fails of Suspense
overview: When comic artist Jane McSween gets locked out of her flat, her day goes from bad to worse when her attempts to break back in result in the accidental death of her neighbour, and draws the attention of a local crimelord.

title: Baggage
overview: A man on the verge of leaving home finds himself unable to let go of the life he's built behind him.

title: Bliss
overview: A worker trapped in the monotony of his office job discovers an emotional escape hidden behind his desktop windows

title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

title: The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)
overview: When ten-year-old Abigail Phillips discovers a forgotten piano deep in the woods on her father's farm, she uncovers more than a passion for music - she unlocks a mystery that spans generations. In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

title: Chirp
overview: A woman's way of life is altered by uninvited guests.

title: Blank Slate City
overview: With music venue closures rising, one musician must turn to the outdoors, creating shows in unique locations to keep the music alive.

title: Escaping Idi Amin
overview: A brutal dictator orders 80,000 people to leave the country within 90 days or face the consequences. Many have British passports. As the deadline looms, will Britain help?

title: Ohana Vendors
overview: A documentary about the incredible employees that work for Blind Vendors "Ohana, the largest employer of blind and low-vision staff in all of Hawai"i.

title: Of the Land
overview: A Samoan musician born and raised in Hawaiʻi, spends the day with his best friend Alex, chasing dreams of music, romance, and a future beyond their everyday lives. But as casual jokes and familiar spaces give way to increasingly painful encounters, the two are forced to confront how differently the place they call home sees them.

title: Lani
overview: Professional golfer Tagiralani Luafalealo navigates her golf journey as the first Samoan woman to play in the LPGA.

title: Picture A Tree
overview: Paul Graviano has molded his life and business around the art and philosophy of bonsai. Evolving a hobby and vast personal collection into a 40-year career growing and shaping miniature trees, Graviano spent time working with legendary bonsai expert Frank Okamura while volunteering at the Brooklyn Botanic Garden before founding the Bonsai of Brooklyn in 1976 – one of the oldest businesses in the U.S. dedicated to the Japanese bonsai tradition.  Now in his eighties, Graviano reflects on the landscape of memory, and a life deeply influenced by plants.

title: Deviant
overview: After a successful video date, Brooklyn invites Cameron over to her rented Airbnb in Joshua Tree to take things to the next level. Their evening soon gets interrupted by a masked intruder who takes them captive with mysterious intentions. To survive the night, they're forced to confront a sordid past that reveals a disturbing connection.

title: Never Call Paul: Commercial
overview: A narrative-less short film adaptation of the crime-comedy podcast Never Call Paul using remastered BTS footage from the EvCo Productions archives.

title: Proposal
overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

title: In The Ever
overview: Blending intimate voice-over with the fractured memories of a 1970s folksinger, IN THE EVER follows Sam Ellis, a mechanic, whose songs written for his dead mother become a surprise hit. Unable to cope with fame, Sam retreats to a desert ranch, where an unexpected love affair forces him to confront his pain in order to move forward.  The film is a love letter infused in music. With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

title: Secrets in a Small Georgia Town
original_title: Secrets in a Small Georgia Town
overview: A corrupt sheriff arrests a woman for killing the man who was sexually assaulting her young daughter. Determined to stand up to the town's power structure, she decides to run against the sheriff in a local election while awaiting her day in court.

title: Crossings
overview: An inspiring story of determination and the human spirit, Crossings follows 23-year-old Edo Tanas, a three-time SUP foil world champion attempting a world first: a three-day solo foiling journey across the Hawaiian archipelago. With nothing more than his board and paddle, Edo journeys more than 270 miles from Hawaiʻi Island to Kauaʻi. As he encounters dangerous channels most boats avoid and endures unpredictable winds, shifting swells, and the physical toll of returning to the water day after day, nothing is guaranteed. Preparation can get Edo to the starting line. From there, the ocean has a say. Will the conditions align? Can his body withstand three days of relentless effort? Edo sets out alone to connect the islands in an entirely new way.

title: Good Help
overview: Between 2023 and 2024, nearly 40,000 Venezuelan migrants were bused from Texas to Denver, Colorado. After traveling more than 3,000 treacherous miles on foot - many with young children in tow - they found themselves living on Denver’s streets in the middle of winter, without housing or legal permission to work.

title: Marguerite
overview: Inspired by a true story, Marguerite recounts the fate of Marguerite de la Rocque, a sixteenth-century noblewoman marooned on an island off Newfoundland, who survives the loss of everything she loves.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: Paul Decembered
overview: Paul Decembered is a cinematic triptych featuring the witty and gritty poetry of Foster Gareau. A tender homage to amateur 2010s camcorder porn that vignettes experiences of intimacy on the market and queer hookup culture.

title: Our Community. Our Canvas.
overview: Following Hamilton Glass, Richmond public artist known for bold murals woven into the city’s landscape, and creatives across Richmond, Philadelphia, Providence, and beyond, the film explores how public art becomes a catalyst for political action and collective healing. Glass reveals how true creative power lies not in the artist alone, but in the communities who help make the work, and who are transformed by it.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: RERUM
overview: RERUM depicts a tense state in which creeping subterranean forces deform and consume images and memory. Shots of fiery processes beneath the Earth’s crust alternate with 8mm footage which captures several generations of families in moments of carefree leisure. The anthropocentric world, where the underground is recalled only by fissures, loses its relevance. This fragile equilibrium is inevitably heading toward destruction.

title: Doggy-Dog World
overview: On the night of his band’s big come-back, a sober musician has a panic attack and locks himself in the green room with a bottle of schnapps. It’s up to his long-suffering best friend to get him through it and get him on stage.

title: Preparing Innineu: Partridge Cleaning in Sheshatshiu
original_title: Preparing Innineu: Partridge Cleaning in Sheshatshiu
overview: Partridges are a common food source for Innu First Nation People in Labrador, especially in Sheshatshiu. Partridge is Innineu in Innu-aimun. This film captures a cultural workshop at the Manishan Nui Gull Island Gathering, filmed by Innu youth Reighlyn Penashue and Karlianna Pokue, with help from emerging filmmakers Heidi Atter and Charlie Pye-Strowbridge.

title: Raffle!
overview: After her parent's tragic death, a ne'er-do-well drifter makes her sibling's worst nightmare come true by trying to take over the family business

title: Famished
overview: Beth struggles with bouts of sleep eating.

title: Holding
overview: While waiting on hold for insurance approval, a sickly man starts to hear unsettling sounds through the line that unravel a sinister secret about his claim.

title: Ho‘olono
overview: Hoʻolono, meaning “to listen deeply,” is a cinematic act of listening and an exploration of return, responsibility, and our evolving relationship to land and self. Hoʻolono is an invitation to listen deeply, to remember that the path through ecological crisis may also be a path back to ourselves.

title: Secrets Of The Viking Ship with Bettany Hughes
original_title: Secrets Of The Viking Ship with Bettany Hughes
overview: The historian investigates the discovery of a group of Viking graves in the eastern Baltic that date back over 1200 years, predating the established start of the Viking era. Bettany follows the investigation from Estonia to Sweden, uncovering how scientists and archaeologists reconstructed the men's origins, kinship and fate, and uncovered a tantalising question. Could one of these warriors have been the legendary Viking king who inspired an epic saga?

title: Gamophobia
overview: Simon is ready to take the next step and start a relationship, but there's one problem: he can't seem to figure out how Jayden truly feels about him. Jayden is more timid when it comes to love, keeping her feelings close to her chest and leaving Simon wondering whether she feels the same way he does.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: Pronouncement of Doom
overview: After being executed by a corrupt king, a knight returns from the dead to seek revenge.

title: Polygala Paniculata
overview: This short student auto-documentary narrates a day in Ngari Mulholland's life that she believes changed her, resembling a format similar to the Australian MY:24 documentary series. It explores, despite being young, the presence of an impactful life lesson through a retrospective lense and ventures into personal discovery, teenagehood and a hopefulness in her inner person that she carries in her life now.

title: The End of Nowhere
overview: A grieving woman wanders the beautiful and mysterious West Texas desert in her car searching for answers in the surreal and supernatural phenomenon known as "The Lights."

title: Saturday
overview: A daughter returns home to be with her mother  as she prepares to make a choice that  generations before her were never allowed to  make.

title: Reina & Valera
overview: The documentary is a production of the Sociedad Bíblica Trinitaria that tells the story of the translation and preservation of the Bible in Spanish.

title: You Know I Love You
overview: In Mexico City, during a visit to their patriarchal grandparents' house, rebellious seven-year-old Lucía and her siblings will stumble upon something that will change their lives forever: their grandfather's revolver.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: The Mis-Summoning
overview: Lucy, a young college student who wants to speak with her late brother. When she tries to summon him back for one night, things don't go exactly how they plan to.

title: The Visitor
overview: Every morning, for a while, Willow Damiani has been waking up on her backyard lawn. She can't remember why or how but when odd occurrences start to happen and a strange figure begins visiting her every night, she begins to question what is real and what isn't.

title: The Girl looking for the cabin
original_title: La Fille à la recherche de la cabane
overview: During the winter of 2011, the young street artist Bilal Berreni travelled to the far north of Sweden and locks himself away in a wooden cabin, to live as a hermit. Ten years later, after Bilal's death, I'm following in his footsteps, looking for his cabin...

title: The Hunt
overview: Detectives are picked off one by one from a seemingly unstoppable force.

title: Congrats on First Chair
overview: Desperate to make memories during the last few months of high school, Emma and her best friend Matt go to the beach where they kiss despite him having a girlfriend.

title: God is Real
overview: After successfully covering up Paul McCartney's death, two CIA agents are tasked with the impossible... convince the entire world that God is real.

title: Quiet Hours
overview: Wyatt is trying to make friends while studying, but this task takes its toll on him.

title: TeleXZikora
overview: Zikora leaves her polished but lonely life in Houston for a semester at Lagos Metropolitan University.

title: Claramé
overview: Meet Clara, a bright and innocent young girl who creates worlds from her vibrant imagination with her father. This gift captures the attention of an untrustworthy friend who is hellbent on morphing her. Through this, Clara learns a lesson about the dangers of naivety and the safety of her father’s love.

title: Satanic Panic
overview: Four RPG players in the 80s are about to get a dose of satanic panic

title: Simon Says So
overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

title: No More Punk Time
overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

title: Inhabitant
overview: Porter, just fired from another job, returns home to find an inhabitant living in the thresholds of his apartment.

title: A Country Dog
overview: Based on Shirley Jackson's short story "The Renegade," A Country Dog follows a family whose move from the city to an isolated rural community promises a fresh start until their beloved dog is accused of killing a neighbor's chickens.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.
